proof_summary: For adjacent divisors \(x,y\), the condition that \(y\) is odd and \(y\ge 2x\) is equivalent to \(y>2x\): oddness rules out equality, while if \(y>2x\) were even, the divisor \(y/2\) would lie strictly between \(x\) and \(y\), contradicting adjacency. Thus the two formulas count exactly the same breaks between consecutive divisors.
